subject: Renewal: Tiered volume commit scenarios & blended routing options
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Thornton <jamie.thornton@retailx.com>, Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@retailx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: Tiered volume commit scenarios & blended routing options

Hi Jamie / Alicia — thanks again for the call today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same picture.

Key points from our discovery:
- Current baseline: ~4M tokens/mo today (inference + embeddings).
- Target runway: RetailX plans to launch expanded features and expects committed volume to ramp to ~15M tokens/mo within 6 months of rollout; long-term target 35–50M tokens/mo.
- Budget signal: initial budget reference mentioned ~$700 / 1M tokens blended (customer-side target).
- Use cases: chat summarization + user recommendations (heavy gen), and a separate high-volume embedding flow for recommendations.

Ask / next steps from Redwood: please confirm the ramp timeline and whether the embedding route should be billed as a separate route (different model/quantization) or folded into a blended contract. Once you confirm, we’ll send 2–3 committed-tier scenarios with blended $/1M token outcomes and an optional embedding-only route price.

Attached: RetailX_usage_telemetry.csv (trimmed sample of month-over-month usage you shared).

Proposed next touchpoints:
1) Ben (cc’d) will follow up with committed-tier pricing scenarios (5/15/35M tiers) and blended examples showing unit economics to your $/1M target.
2) If those align, we’ll produce a short SOW + procurement-ready line items and a 30-day validation window for the blended route.

Thanks — I’ll keep this tight.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: RetailX_usage_telemetry.csv (CSV, 42 KB)
From: Jamie Thornton <jamie.thornton@retailx.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@retailx.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: Tiered volume commit scenarios & blended routing options

Thanks Sergio — that recap looks right. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Ramp: we expect a soft launch in mid-Q1 that would push committed usage to ~8–10M tokens/mo within 60 days, then to ~15M/mo by the end of Q2. The full expanded feature set could approach ~40M tokens/mo in 6–9 months if adoption hits plan.
- Budget: the $700 / 1M tokens is a ballpark for blended costs we can justify for now; if you can show a blended scenario that hits <$700/1M at the 15M committed level we can escalate internally.
- Embeddings: we’d prefer embeddings to be a separate route (different SLA/latency tolerance). They’re high-volume but lower latency sensitivity.

Requests for Ben / Redwood:
1) Please send a matrix showing committed tiers (5M, 15M, 35M) with the per‑1M price for each tier and the blended $/1M outcome for the full commitment.
2) Show the incremental uplift for adding a separate embedding route (e.g., embedding-only pricing and expected blended impact).
3) Clarify minimum commitment term and whether we can start with a 30-day validation before the full commitment kicks in.

We’d like a procurement-ready PDF/line-item summary after we pick a scenario.

Best,
Jamie Thornton
Head of Product — Search & Recommendations
RetailX

On Fri, Dec 4, 2027 at 2:05 PM Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Jamie / Alicia — thanks again for the call today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same picture.
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Thornton <jamie.thornton@retailx.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: Tiered volume commit scenarios & blended routing options

Jamie — thanks for the clarity. Per your asks, below are 3 committed scenarios and an optional embedding-only route. I’ll attach a downloadable spreadsheet with line items and blended math (RetailX_pricing_v3.xlsx).

Committed-tier scenarios (per-1M token pricing):
- Scenario A — Conservative commit (5M tokens/mo):
  • 0–5M tier price: $1,200 / 1M tokens
  • Blended @5M = $1,200 / 1M (single-tier)
  • Minimum term: 6 months (shorter term higher price)

- Scenario B — Mid ramp (15M tokens/mo):
  • 0–5M: $1,200 / 1M
  • 5–15M: $900 / 1M
  • Blended @15M = ((5*1200)+(10*900))/15 = $966 / 1M tokens
  • Estimated monthly bill at blended: ~$14,490 (15 * $966) — note: we show both blended and explicit tier math in the attachment.

- Scenario C — Aggressive (35M tokens/mo):
  • 0–5M: $1,200 / 1M
  • 5–15M: $900 / 1M
  • 15–50M: $650 / 1M
  • Blended @35M ≈ $780 / 1M (attachment has exact calc)

Embedding-only route (optional):
- Purpose-built embedding route (quantized model, lower latency SLA): $350 / 1M tokens for high volume (>10M embedding tokens / mo).
- If embeddings are moved to their own route, the blended generative-route price improves ~5–12% depending on split (we model splits at 10/20/30% embedding traffic in the spreadsheet).

Other notes / concessions we can offer for a 12-month committed term:
- One-time onboarding credit: $10k (applies to first invoice).
- 60% discount on the first 2 weeks of overflow routing (used only during rollout).
- Optional 30-day validation period: we can start with a 30-day trial where redirected traffic is meter‑billed at demo rates; if you convert to a committed tier within the 30 days, we’ll credit trial usage toward the commitment.

Next steps I propose:
1) You pick the scenario that best matches internal risk tolerance (A/B/C) and confirm whether embeddings are separate.
2) I’ll produce a procurement-ready SOW + pricing appendix and a DocuSign link for signature.
3) Enable a 30-day validation window and schedule an ops sync to confirm routing and KV-cache behavior before rollout.

Attachments: RetailX_pricing_v3.xlsx (Excel, 78 KB)

On Sat, Dec 5, 2027 at 9:22 AM Jamie Thornton <jamie.thornton@retailx.com> wrote:
> Thanks Sergio — that recap looks right. A couple clarifications from our side...
From: Jamie Thornton <jamie.thornton@retailx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@retailx.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: Tiered volume commit scenarios & blended routing options

Ben — this is very helpful, thank you. A few quick responses and asks so procurement can move forward:

- Scenario B (15M) looks closest to our risk profile. Blended ~$966/1M is above our target, but the 12-month term + onboarding credit might make it workable. Can you run a sensitivity that gets blended to <$700/1M (our goal) — what minimum committed volume or discount level would achieve that?
- We will take the embedding route as a separate route; please include the embedding line item in the SOW and show the blended impact in the attachment.
- Procurement wants: 1) a single PDF with line items, 2) a clear term (12 months?), 3) a worksheet that shows the monthly ramp and billing breakout.

Also — we want to run a 30-day validation prior to committing. Can Redwood enable a validation where up to 50% traffic is routed to your committed endpoints and is billed at demonstration rates, with credits if we convert? If yes, include that text in the SOW.

If you can get me a PDF + DocuSign by Friday, I’ll push this through our procurement queue next week.

Thanks — looking forward to the spreadsheet + SOW.

Best,
Jamie
